title: BOS-659 — credentials retained after an unconfirmed WorkOS refresh render as a 'Sign in required' warning with [l]ogin, not as a silent logout

scenes.title: Home's auth poll reads the retained re-login marker and explains why sign-in is needed while the local session board keeps working

waitFor.label: Home surfaces the retained re-login state instead of silently reverting to a never-logged-in board

steps.caption: The seeded keychain record is kept but flagged: Home's first auth poll turns it into a warning, not a logout
Before BOS-659 an ambiguous refresh deleted workos-tokens outright — there was no email, no reason, and nothing on screen to explain the sign-out

expect.text: refresh outcome could not be confirmed
expect.label: the enumerated refresh_outcome_unknown reason is rendered as plain prose — never a raw WorkOS payload or token
the warning scopes the damage: only cloud auth is paused, local session management is untouched
[l]ogin — the action bar offers the one remedy that clears the marker, so the flagged record is treated as signed out

steps.caption: Reason, blast radius, and remedy are all on the captured frame

expect.label: the session table still renders beneath the warning — a flagged cloud credential does not take the TUI down

steps.caption: The board is unchanged: this is a paused cloud connection, not a broken client
